info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Employee Evaluation Review-spec
info.description: The Employee Evaluation Review API facilitates the process of submitting reviews for employee evaluations within an organization. This endpoint is essential for HR departments and managers who conduct periodic assessments of employee performance. By utilizing this API, authorized users can efficiently submit comprehensive evaluation reviews, ensuring structured feedback and performance documentation. Typical consumers include human resource personnel, team leaders, and organizational administrators who manage employee evaluation processes.
